newsitem.title: USA: Industrial Services see record 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: Industrial Services see record 1996 results.

text.p: Industrial Services of America Inc said Tuesday it expects record sales and earnings for 1996, and its board is considering a stock dividend.
In 1995 Industrial Services reported revenues of $30.5 million and net income of $704,159, or $0.41 per share.
For the first nine months of 1996, earnings rose to $580,445, or $0.32 per share, from $549,481, or $0.30 per share, a year earlier.
The company gave no details on the possible stock dividend.
Industrial Services is a provider of waste management and recycling services to corporate customers in the U.S. and Canada.
